other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the economically weaker section of society

Applicant must be suffering from specified diseases such as Parkinson's disease, Malignant Cancer, Paralysis, Muscular Dystrophy, Hemophilia, Thalassemia, chronic renal failure or any other disease that permanently incapacitates a person
Applicant must not be a beneficiary of any other government-sponsored pension scheme
benefits_summary: Eligible beneficiaries receive financial assistance of Rs. 3,000 per month to mitigate hardships during prolonged treatment.
